typography.strategy: Soft Utility pairing. Clean, readable, and highly accessible for medical contexts. Avoid 'Inter' for headings.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces ONLY. No glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction of clinical data. Crisp 1px solid borders for separation.
visual_enhancers.corners: Soft 12px radius for standard elements. Message bubbles should have asymmetric radii (e.g. bot: rounded-tr-2xl rounded-br-2xl rounded-bl-2xl rounded-tl-sm). Quick replies must be pill-shaped (rounded-full).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows (shadow-sm) for the bottom navigation bar and sticky header. Do not use heavy drop shadows.

components.name: MobileContainer
components.description: A wrapper limiting width on desktop to simulate a mobile app (max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] flex flex-col bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative).

components.name: BottomNavigation
components.description: Fixed bottom tab bar. Order: Home, Scan, Chat, Settings. Active tab (Chat) highlighted in primary color.

components.name: ChatArea
components.description: Flex-1 overflow-y-auto container with padding. Messages flow from bottom up. Smooth scrolling.

components.name: MessageBubble
components.description: Distinct styles for user vs bot. Bot includes a small avatar icon (lucide-react Bot). User aligned right, Bot aligned left.

components.name: QuickReplies
components.description: Horizontal scrollable list (hide scrollbar) of pill-shaped action buttons pinned right above the bottom tab bar or inline in chat.

components.name: ConfirmationDrawer
components.description: Shadcn Drawer or Dialog for critical actions ('Stop future reminders'). Solid background, NO transparent overlays. Explicit red destructive button.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Mobile-first flexbox layout. Strict hierarchy. Header (sticky top), Chat Area (flex-1 scroll), Input/QuickReplies (sticky bottom), Bottom Nav (fixed bottom).

motion.strategy: Micro-interactions. Fade-up for new messages. Slide-up for the quick reply drawer. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Spring transitions for dialogs.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against bot/user bubbles passes WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1).
accessibility.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='chat-tab-button', data-testid='quick-reply-pause', data-testid='confirm-stop-button').

icons_and_media.strategy: Use lucide-react for all icons. Avoid AI emojis. Use crisp SVG paths.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a web-based UI that precisely emulates a React Native mobile application experience using React and Tailwind.
Add the 'Chat' tab positioned exactly between 'Scan' and 'Settings'.
Implement a purely deterministic chat state machine in React state (no external AI APIs).
Support the following flows via predefined quick replies: Pause/resume reminders, dismiss today's reminder, change time, and MedicPal app FAQs.
Use a Shadcn Dialog or Drawer for the explicit confirmation required to stop Google Calendar events / future reminders.
Ensure overlays do NOT have fully transparent backgrounds. Use solid or highly opaque colors to maintain text readability.
Make sure all components are .js compatible as the environment uses standard Javascript, not Typescript.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use flat solid colors for health apps (no glass).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
